name: qa-analyst
description: Autonomous QA copilot for VS Code / Claude Code: requirement analysis, test planning, and test-case generation straight from the project folder you have open -- name its requirement and knowledge-base folders with --req "<folder>" and --kb "<folder>". No settings file, and nothing written into your folders but the deliverables. Test automation is out of scope -- handled by a separate agent setup that consumes this plugin's generated test cases.
